```{=html}
<style>#title-block-header { display: none !important; }</style>
<div class="page-header">
  <h1>{{< meta title >}}</h1>
</div>
<p class="post-meta-line">
  <time class="post-date" id="post-date-raw" datetime="{{< meta date >}}">{{< meta date >}}</time>
  &nbsp;·&nbsp;
  <span class="post-categories">Category &nbsp;·&nbsp; Category</span>
</p>
<hr class="post-rule">
<script>
(function() {
  var el = document.getElementById('post-date-raw');
  if (!el || !el.dateTime) return;
  var d = new Date(el.dateTime + 'T00:00:00');
  var months = ['January','February','March','April','May','June','July','August','September','October','November','December'];
  el.textContent = d.getDate() + ' ' + months[d.getMonth()] + ' ' + d.getFullYear();
})();
</script>
```
